columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Timestamp when the event was ingested into Log Analytics.

columns.name: Ts
columns.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the telephony event from Duo (ts field).

columns.name: Context
columns.description: Context for the telephony event: authentication, enrollment, verification, or administrator bypass.

columns.name: Credits
columns.description: Number of telephony credits consumed by this event.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: E.164 formatted phone number involved in the event (e.g. +17083051906).

columns.name: TelephonyId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the telephony event.

columns.name: TxId
columns.description: Transaction ID linking this telephony event to an authentication transaction.

columns.name: TelephonyType
columns.description: Telephony channel used: sms (passcode delivered via text) or phone (callback call placed).
